name: Ranger Wingman: 2% less damage taken per active War Falcon (#481)
contract: Wingman 705098 (Ranger Survival talent, CharacterAdvancement tab 2) reads 'Reduces all damage taken by $680278s3% for each War Falcon or Dragonhawk you have active.' Its effect 2 is SPELL_AURA_MOD_DAMAGE_PERCENT_TAKEN, MiscValue 127 (all schools), BasePoints -1 + DieSides 1 = 0, so the passive alone reduces nothing. $680278s3 is effect 2 of 680278 'War Falcon' ('Shows how many War Falcons you have active'), BasePoints -3 + DieSides 1 = -2; the Dragonhawk counterpart 681394 has the same -2. That effect is an ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER SPELLMOD_EFFECT3 whose class mask (0x80000, 0, 0) selects Wingman (SpellFamilyFlags 0x80000), i.e. the client design adds -2 to Wingman's damage-taken effect per active falcon; 680278's own effects 0/1 reach the owner as APPLY_AREA_AURA_OWNER with radius index 12 = 100 yd. No War Falcon template carries 680278, so the count never reaches the Ranger. Falcon Dive 806341 is a self-cast with two SPELL_EFFECT_SUMMON effects of creature 50393 'War Falcon' (SummonProperties 61, a guardian) and DurationIndex 29 = 12000 ms, so it gives exactly two active falcons. Expected: with Wingman learned, Wingman's effect 2 amount is 0 and incoming melee damage is unchanged before the dive; with two falcons active it is -4 and a fixed 1000 melee hit from the golem is scaled to 960 (ratio 0.96); after the falcons expire it returns to 0 and 1000. Before the fix the amount stays 0 and the ratio 1.0.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
SETUP: Wingman is active on the Ranger
Without a War Falcon Wingman reduces nothing
Falcon Dive calls two War Falcons
SETUP: two War Falcons are active
Wingman's damage-taken effect is -2% per War Falcon
Two War Falcons reduce incoming damage by 4%
The War Falcons leave after 12 seconds
Wingman's reduction ends with the falcons
